ground_truth: An iterative optimization algorithm that steps in the direction opposite to the gradient of the loss function to reach a minimum.
pre_quiz: Why does gradient descent take steps in the negative direction of the derivative?
pre_quiz_answer: Because the gradient points in the direction of steepest increase, so the negative gradient points toward steepest decrease.
post_quiz: What happens if the learning rate in gradient descent is chosen to be too large?
post_quiz_answer: The updates will overshoot the minimum and may diverge rather than converging.
